STUDENT EXAM RESULT PREDICTION - OFFLINE
Copy this entire folder to the offline Windows PC.
Run RUN_APP.bat or RUN_APP.ps1.
No Python, pip, Flask, NumPy, SciPy, or scikit-learn installation is needed on the target PC.
Browser opens at http://127.0.0.1:5000.
Keep the application console window open while using the application.
